name: io.github.baseclf/baseclf
description: Row-level security and auto-REST for Cloudflare D1, on your own account

deployment.description: Hostname of the Worker you deployed with npx create-baseclf. There is no shared endpoint: BaseCLF runs on your own Cloudflare account and reads your own database.

token.description: The MCP_TOKEN secret on that Worker. Set it with: npx baseclf secret set MCP_TOKEN. Without it every request to /mcp is refused, which is the intended state for a deployment nobody configured.
